talkItOver.name: how-to-pray-1-the-purpose-of-prayer
talkItOver.richText:
How to Pray

The Purpose of Prayer

Encuentra esta guía en español: www.life.church/notas 

Message Summary

Prayer is simply talking with God, but sometimes it’s challenging to do. If we don’t know the purpose for our prayers, it’s easy for them to become our last resort or a check-box item before bed.

The purpose of prayer is not to get something from God, but to be with Him and become like Him.

Key Scripture

“This, then, is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name, your kingdom come, your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us today our daily bread. And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”
Matthew 6:9-13 NIV

Additional Scriptures

  • Luke 5:16 NIV
  • Luke 6:12 NIV
  • Luke 9:18 NIV
  • Luke 9:28 NIV
  • Luke 11:1 NIV
  • Matthew 6:5-8 NIV

Start talking. Find a conversation starter for your group.

  • What words, thoughts, or feelings come to mind when you think about prayer?

Start thinking. Ask a question to get your group thinking.

  • On a scale of 1-10, where would you rank your confidence in your ability to pray? What would help you move closer to a 10?
  • Read Matthew 6:9-13. What does this prayer show you about our relationship with God? What character traits of His are highlighted?

Start sharing. Choose a question to create openness.

  • The purpose of prayer is to be with God and become like Him. What obstacles make prayer challenging for you, and how can you begin breaking those barriers this week?
  • Think about where you hope your life will be one year from now. How would building a habit of prayer impact your life and your hopes for the future? What would other people notice that’s different about you?

Start praying. Be bold and pray with power.

Father in heaven, hallowed be Your name. Thank You for not just telling us to pray, but for showing us how to pray through the life of Jesus. We long to know You more personally. Help us commit to building a regular habit of prayer that starts today. In Jesus’ name, amen.

Start doing. Commit to a step and live it out this week.

  • Find a time and place where you’ll pray every day this week and commit to making it part of your routine.
  • Start the Bible Plan 7 Biblical Prayers and How to Pray Them Today using Plans With Friends: www.go2.lc/prayers
  • Consider how you could love others by serving on the weekend
    (www.life.church/serving) or with a Local Mission Partner
    (www.life.church/localmissions).

latestCollection.name: How to Pray
latestCollection.description: Ever wondered if prayer actually works—or how to even do it? It seems like a good thing, but you don’t want to get it wrong. What if it's simpler than you think? Let's learn How to Pray together.
latestCollection.title: How to Pray
latestCollection.headline: It’s simpler than you think.

pastCollections.name: Heal Your Hurting Mind
pastCollections.description: Do you ever feel trapped by your thoughts and emotions? On the outside you’re holding it together, but inside you’re struggling. If you wonder if you’ll ever feel better, you're not alone. There’s hope and a path toward healing.
pastCollections.title: Heal Your Hurting Mind
pastCollections.headline: There’s a path toward healing.

pastCollections.name: A Church That Pleases God
pastCollections.description: More than anything, we want to be a church that pleases God. We'll explore the qualities the Bible says matter most—faith-filled, bold, and loving. A Church That Pleases God is made of people who want to please Him.
pastCollections.title: A Church That Pleases God
pastCollections.headline: Faith-filled. Bold. Loving.

pastCollections.name: More Days Than Not
pastCollections.description: We all get excited about “new year, new goals”—but what's the secret to habits that last? What if being perfect isn't as impactful as being consistent? In this message, discover how showing up More Days Than Not can lead to habits that stick.
pastCollections.title: More Days Than Not
pastCollections.headline: The secret to healthy habits that last.

pastCollections.name: He Will Be Called
pastCollections.description: You might be feeling a lot of things this Christmas—and not all of them joyful. Maybe you're struggling with loneliness or feeling unseen. Jesus meets you right where you're at. Discover who He is and what that means for you in our new series.
pastCollections.title: He Will Be Called
pastCollections.findHashtags: Spiritual Growth, Spiritual Direction, The Church
pastCollections.headline: Hope has a name.

pastCollections.name: This Is What We Do
pastCollections.description: When times are tough, being generous seems impossible. We want to care for those around us, but where do we even start? How can we possibly make a difference? Together, let's learn how in our new series, This Is What We Do.
pastCollections.title: This Is What We Do
pastCollections.headline: This is what we do, because this is who we are.

pastCollections.name: From One to a Billion
pastCollections.description: In a world searching for truth, God’s Word is reaching people like never before. We’re celebrating one billion installs across the YouVersion Family of Apps. And you’re part of the story. See what can happen From One to a Billion.
pastCollections.title: From One to a Billion
pastCollections.headline: God’s Word is reaching people like never before.

pastCollections.name: The Connected Life
pastCollections.description: We live in the most connected age in history, yet loneliness is at an all-time high. Technology can draw us closer—or leave us isolated. The answer isn't ditching devices; it's learning to live The Connected Life and build meaningful relationships.
pastCollections.title: The Connected Life
pastCollections.headline: Reset your relationships. Reconnect to what matters.

pastCollections.name: Living in the Last Days
pastCollections.description: Feeling overwhelmed by life? You're not alone. When everything feels uncertain, we often worry about what’s next. But what if it's possible to regain perspective and purpose? Let’s learn to see past our circumstances to the truths that sustain us.
pastCollections.title: Living in the Last Days
pastCollections.headline: The truths that sustain us.

pastCollections.name: Elisha
pastCollections.description: Tired of feeling stuck while life passes you by? Ready to stop wondering “what if” and step into what’s next? In our new series, Elisha, we’ll see what happens when we leave comfort behind and pursue our true purpose.
pastCollections.title: Elisha
pastCollections.headline: Live your calling.
